expectations.name: audit-defaults-to-the-diff
expected_behavior: Audits `craft:cm` only — the skill the diff touches — and not `go:style`
Reports the contract conflict as a Blocker and the oversized section as a token finding, each with its `file:line` and the command that fixes it
Edits no file, commits nothing, and runs no agent case
Reports tersely: one line per finding, most severe first, no narration of the scan

expectations.name: run-asks-before-agent-cases
expected_behavior: Runs lint and the routine tiers first, without asking
States the 5 cases, their count, and the estimate, and asks before running any; on the user's no, runs none
Reports per tier the counts and the cost, read off the tool output

expectations.name: fix-commits-each-improvement
expected_behavior: Writes the test for each improvement before the edit (a probe that fails at the base, or a contract phrase)
Commits each improvement on its own, staging only the files it changed; `README.md` stays uncommitted and unstaged
Writes no `LESSONS.md` for `craft:cm`; names the user's correction for `/craft:skill-enhance`
Reports each commit's hash and summary tersely, with open questions at the end
